title: ThEA Direct Swab Protocol
author: Miriam Schwartz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bkh4kt8w
materials: Initialize measurement, data logging software (ThEA measurement) and analysis (ThEA Analysis) software.
Open 'ThEA' analysis software and load 'Reference' file followed by 'Measurement' file and press 'Analyze'
Open 'ThEA' analysis software and load 'Reference' file followed by 'Measurement' file and press 'Analyze'

steps.title: Perform Hourly Air Calibration
steps.instruction: Take a measurement of air (no sample in beam optical path) and save the Air spectrum to the database once per hour.

steps.title: Perform Hourly Substrate Calibration
steps.instruction: Immediately following the air measurement, scan the barcode and take a measurement of the provided calibration cartridge to save the Substrate spectrum to the database once per hour.

steps.title: Prepare Environment and Equipment
steps.instruction: Start the temperature and humidity logger and the barcode scanner. Ensure the entire experiment is conducted at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect and Apply Sample
steps.instruction: Take an oropharyngeal swab and smear it on the sensor surface two times in an 'x' pattern.

steps.title: Enter Patient Metadata and Cartridge Info
steps.instruction: Enter patient sample metadata into the ThEA measurement software, including sourcing and traceability details (without compromising personal information), and scan the barcode of the 'ThEA Rapid' cartridge to be used.

steps.title: Acquire Reference Spectrum
steps.instruction: Insert the cartridge in the cartridge holder, press 'Reference', and take a measurement of the bare sensor to obtain the Reference spectrum for every patient sample.

steps.title: Acquire Measurement Spectrum
steps.instruction: Insert the cartridge in the cartridge holder, press 'Measurement', and take a measurement of the sensors to save the Measurement spectrum to the database.

steps.title: Process Calibration Cartridge
steps.instruction: Insert the calibration cartridge in the cartridge holder and press 'Substrate'.

steps.title: Review Results
steps.instruction: Read the result displayed on the screen; possible outcomes are 'Positive', 'Negative', or 'Inconclusive'.

steps.title: Clean Up and Storage
steps.instruction: Dispose of the one-time use sensor and the swab according to local disposal rules. Return the calibration cartridge to its original packaging for future use.

steps.title: Repeat with Advanced Cartridge
steps.instruction: Take a new oropharyngeal swab and repeat the process from metadata entry through measurement acquisition using a 'ThEA Advanced' cartridge.
